faq.question: What is the origin of Shabani?
faq.answer: Shabani is associated with Arabic. Shabani is the Swahili form of Arabic شَعْبَان (Shaʿbān), the name of a lunar month, used as a male given name.

faq.question: Is Shabani an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form شَعْبَانُ is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Shabani an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Shabani can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
